independent_human_review_protocol.review_model: Double-Blind Independent Human Dual Review with Lead Adjudication
written_adjudication_guidelines: Guideline 1 (Entity Isolation): The subject must represent the financial line-item or operative transaction construct (Total, Tax, Payment, Late payment). Generic invoice totals represent governed financial commitments.
Guideline 2 (Deontic Modality): Amounts owed and due dates carry mandatory obligation (MUST). Discretionary penalties or administration fees carry conditional permission (MAY).
Guideline 3 (Verbatim Grounding): Evidence text spans must be exact substrings of the invoice visual artifact.
Guideline 4 (Double-Blind Independence): Reviewers evaluate claims independently without access to automated rule matcher outputs, each other notes, or the benchmark gold key.
Guideline 5 (Lead Arbitration): Discrepancies between reviewers are arbitrated by the Principal Benchmark Steward under Evaluation Contract v1.0.0.

independent_human_review_protocol.scientific_validity_notice: An automated matcher cannot serve as an independent annotator for validating its own matching logic. High agreement demonstrates consistency across annotators, not correctness; agreement metrics do not by themselves establish that annotators measured the intended construct accurately (ArXiv:2603.06865, LREC-COLING). N=5 sample size cannot certify production autonomy.
